text: Hello everyone, welcome back to my class.In the last period, we read the passage entitled The Next Big Thing.In today's class, we are going to dig deep into the passage.At the end of this period, you are expected to understand the writer's mother's job responsibilities and her attitude towards emerging technologies, interpret the implied meaning of the sentences by paraphrasing key words and expressions, understand people's different attitudes towards emerging technologies, and explore the driving force for the advance in technology.Please get your textbook and worksheet ready.In the previous lesson, we have been introduced to three big things by the writer.Do you still remember what they are?Yes, they are mobile social networking, the video phone hardware, and AR.Did they all succeed?We know that, unfortunately, the days of the video phone hardware were through with the emergence of the video chat app.Then, can the writer make correct predictions?The answer is also negative.Then, what did she think of emerging technologies?Yes, unpredictable.We learned from the writer's experiences with those big things that it is unpredictable whether an emerging technology will succeed or not later.And it's difficult to predict the future of a new technology with limited success.Also, the past technology can become unnecessary as new products are developed.The writer's story proves that.With experiences comes insight.How is it possible for the writer to come in contact with so many big things?Yes, thanks to her mother.So in this lesson, we are going to read the passage again and finish the profile of her mother together.First, what is her mother's job?Please scan the whole passage and find out the answer.You will have 20 seconds.Okay.What is her mother's job?Yes, she is an emerging technologies consultant.The answer is in paragraph 6.The future arrived much earlier in our house than anywhere else.Because my mother is an emerging technologies consultant.Now let's take a look at this sentence.What does the writer mean by the future arrived much earlier in our house than anywhere else?Can you use your own words to explain it?Okay, for me, it means the writer could experience those new technologies in their emerging stage before they were available in the market.The writer's mother, as an emerging technologies consultant, plays a significant role in introducing the future into their house.Then, what does her mother actually do as an emerging technologies consultant?I'd like you to read the whole passage and underline the sentences in the text that describe her mother's job.You will have three minutes for the task.Okay, thank you.Okay, let me share what I found with you.First, I found in paragraph 6, she has lived by her unusual ability to see beyond the primitive early versions of new tech to the faint outlines of another reality just over the horizon.Here, we come across two phrases, the faint outlines and over the horizon.What do they mean?Can you explain them in your own words?An outline is the line that goes around the edge of something, showing its general shape but not the details.A faint outline refers to an unclear and uncertain future.The horizon is the line in the far distance where the sky seems to meet the land or the sea.If something is on the horizon or over the horizon, it is out of reach at the moment but likely to happen soon.By using these two phrases, the writer tells us that her mother is very sensitive to emergent technologies.Even though these technologies are still premature, her mother can still explore the infinite of emergent technologies, which is her first job responsibility.Now let's move on to the second sentence in paragraph 7.The writer tells us that she wrote reports about the state of the market, which at that point was a slender stream of early adopters.Here we know that her mother did research and wrote reports on whether the market is mature for certain emergent technologies.But why does the writer use a slender stream of early adopters?What can you infer from it?According to the note on your textbook, slender means small or very limited in amount.The writer indicates that at that time there were only a very small number of people using such a technology.And the writer's mother studied the market for video conferencing at a very early stage.On this sentence, we can conclude the second job responsibility of her mother.Do research and write reports on market possibility.Now we have had a clear picture of her mother's job responsibilities as an emergent technologies consultant.And according to the writer, her mother did a really good job due to her unusual ability.To better illustrate this unusual ability, the writer uses an example in paragraph 8.Please read paragraph 8, underline the example, and think about the implied meaning.You will have 30 seconds for the task.OK, have you found the example?John, can you share what you have found with us?I found the example in paragraph 8, from line 42 to 47.In the 1990s, she ordered pains with her consultancy name and the slogan, Remember when we could only hear each other?Years later, when an unopened box of them surfaced in her office, she laughed and laughed.From this example, I can infer that the mother was very happy to see her prediction about the video conferencing technology become a reality.It shows her mother is far sighted.Yes, the example tells us the writer's mother had foreseen the coming of video conferencing technology.She was really happy and proud to see her prediction come true several years later, which proves she can see the potentials of new technology and make accurate predictions about future technology.Then, when did she lose interest in this technology and why?Please read paragraph 10 to find out the answers.Jane, can you share your answers with us?The writer's mother lost interest in videoconferencing technology after the video revolution came.That's when the technology became popular and mature.However, her mother was only interested in the new technologies full of potential and information.She was also interested in video conferencing technology.Her mother was only interested in the new technologies full of potential and in its infancy.Therefore, she no longer showed interest in the video conferencing technology.Yes, I agree with you.In paragraph 10, the writer says her mother's interest was in premature things full of potential and ready to take their place in the world in need of her talents.The writer indicates that her mother's interests and talents are in discovering promising early ideas rather than fully developed products.Now, do you have a better understanding of her mother's unusability?Can you summarize her capabilities based on what we have read?You will have one minute to write them down on the profile.Okay, here is what I have written.An eye for the potentials.An acute insight into the future.And a talent for discovering promising early ideas.Now, by reading between the lines, we have got a clear picture of her mother's job responsibilities and her capabilities.What about her attitude towards emerging technologies?Can you use an adjective to describe it?Yes, it's not difficult to conclude that she was quite optimistic about them.Obviously, compared with the writer, she has a slightly different attitude towards emerging technologies.The writer is a little doubtful about emerging technologies because she thinks they are unpredictable.However, her mother is quite hopeful about future technological advances.Even though technology is calm and go, she is still optimistic about emerging technologies.But how come the writer and her mother who live under the same roof hold different attitudes towards emerging technologies?Can you think about the possible causes for such differences based on the text?You will have one minute.Jennifer, what is your opinion?I think it is mainly because of her job.As an emerging technologies consultant, the writer's mother is more familiar with new technologies and their development, and have more confidence in technological advance.Besides, the life experience due to the age gap between them may also be a cause.Yes, I can't agree more.They hold different attitudes because of her mother's job and all the experiences and familiarity with emerging technologies that come with it.Then, do you think the writer realized the difference between them?Please read the last paragraph and underline some details to support your answer.Okay, here is my opinion.I think the writer also realized the difference.Because she writes, I don't have all the hallmarks of a standard techie.Here, the word hallmark means the distinguishing features.While techie refers to someone who knows a lot about technology, just like her mother.The sentence implies that, unlike her mother, she isn't a typical addict to technologies, whose cell phones stay connected to the internet, and who belong to many social networks.Then, why did she add, but I am from a bubble in time?What does a bubble in time mean?A bubble in time refers to a fortunate situation that is isolated from reality and unconstrained by time.The writer uses this expression to indicate that, thanks to her mother's work, she has earlier access to various technologies, which allows her to more accurately predict whether those technologies will succeed or fail in the future.From the writer's description, we can tell that, despite different attitudes towards emerging technologies, the writer's mother had a great influence on her in terms of technological advancement.And thanks to thousands of people like her mother, emerging technologies arise one after another.When they become mainstream technologies, they will shape our life greatly for the better.So, here is another question for you.Based on what we have learned from the writer's mother and your experiences with emerging technologies, what are the driving forces of technological advancement?You will have one minute to prepare.
